description: Get the final price of the quote the customer chose. Call it first with bundleId only: that selects the quote and returns the status, which may list what the final price still needs, then a confirmation. After the customer says yes to that confirmation, call again with its token and the customer's exact reply. Nothing is requested unless requested comes back true.

bundleId.description: The bundleId of the chosen quote.

confirmation.description: Omit on the first call, which selects the quote and returns the confirmation to show.

token.description: The status confirmation's token; a changed fact makes it stale.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key for safely retrying this customer action

intentId.description: The shopping intent id returned by an earlier shopping tool.

name: jerry_request_final_price
title: Request final price
